purpose: Establish the complex in its site context from high altitude before descending to the facade.

framing.subject: complex footprint centred, roofline in upper third

constraints: camera heading at exit matches facade-flyby entry heading within 5 degrees
same site origin and axis convention

validation: building silhouette in frame at t=0 and t=6 matches the Blender scene render (masked silhouette pixel diff under agreed threshold)
no geometry object outside site bounds (assets/geometry check)
